ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the
Residential Planned Development Number 723 District symbols and indications as
shown on Map No. 14-D and 16-D in the area bound by:

       South Woodlawn Avenue; the alley next north of and parallel to East 63rd Street; South
       Kenwood Avenue; East 63rd Street; a line 90.77 feet west of and parallel to South
       Kenwood Avenue; a line 103.64 feet south of and parallel to East 63rds Street; a line
       134 feet west of and parallel to South Kenwood Avenue; and the alley next south of and
       parallel to East 63rd Street,

to those of a RM-5, Residential Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                         ____________________________
                                                         Jeanette B. Taylor
                                                         Alderwoman, 20th Ward




Common Address:
1200-1328 E. 63rd Street
1201-1321 E. 63rd Street
